filled.description: Draw filled polygons and point circles.

extruded.description: Extrude Polygon and MultiPolygon features using getElevation.

wireframe.description: Draw a wireframe of extruded polygons. Exclusive with solid fill when extruded.

getFillColor.description: Constant RGB(A) color (0-255), or an arrow function of one feature, f, that returns one. If omitted, deck.gl default [0, 0, 0, 255] is used.

getLineColor.description: Constant RGB(A) color (0-255), or an arrow function of one feature, f, that returns one. If omitted, deck.gl default [0, 0, 0, 255] is used.

getElevation.description: Arrow function of one feature, f. Returns extrusion height in meters. Only used when extruded is true. If omitted, deck.gl default 1000 is used.
